t: Independent since 1818, after the Army of the Andes defeated the royalists at Chacabuco and Maipú.
The Constitution of 1833 gave it rare stability, and victory in the War of the Pacific made it a regional power.
Salvador Allende was overthrown in 1973; Pinochet’s dictatorship lasted until the return of democracy in 1990.
dyk: Andrés Bello, a Venezuelan scholar who settled in Chile, wrote its Civil Code of 1855, which was later adopted by Ecuador and Colombia.
ev: Independence is proclaimed and secured at the Battle of Maipú
A new constitution creates a strong presidential state
Victory at Yungay ends the Peru–Bolivian Confederation
The War of the Pacific begins against Peru and Bolivia
Congress defeats President Balmaceda in a civil war
Augusto Pinochet’s coup overthrows Salvador Allende on 11 September
Voters reject Pinochet in a plebiscite
Democracy returns under President Patricio Aylwin

f.predecessor: Patria Vieja; Captaincy General of Chile
